headline: Türkiye Appoints New Capital Markets Board Chair After Fund Crisis
summary: Muhsin Atcı has been named chair of Turkey's Capital Markets Board (SPK), with Ersin Başar Ekmekci appointed as deputy chair following a fund crisis.
why: The Capital Markets Board is Turkey's financial market regulator, and leadership changes affect regulatory oversight and investor confidence in local capital markets.
